verdicts.reason: Ledger record Rodriguez Shipbuilding (formerly Rodriguez Boat Builders) - Coden main yard, 14843 Alba Ave, Coden (status base). The WWJ article (Mar 13, 2026) names only the company 'of Bayou La Batre' building sections for Verret, not a yard; OSHA 2025 has one Rodriguez Shipbuilding record, at the Coden address. The Bayou La Batre back-up yards (EPA FRS Yards 2-4, Shell Belt Rd / W Davenport St) remain unverified (no dated construction source naming them). Lead: Rodriguez -> Verret section supply link (company level).

Inactive yard: Naval Marine Archive (updated July 2021) says 'It is now inactive' (14530 Shell Belt Road; EPA FRS BOCONCO INC same address); boconco.com is an expired GoDaddy parked domain; latest listed build 2007; no OSHA 2025 record. No new construction in five years.
Ledger record Vessel Repair (Port Arthur shipyard), 5848 Procter Ext, Port Arthur (status profiled). Matcher artifact.

Not in ledger (closure-B left it as a lead). Towboats built at its Bourg yard (Larry Gravely, delivered 2026; Edwin Rider, completed Aug 2026, Marine Log). USCG manufacturer record: 265 Company Canal Rd., Bourg, factory same, in business. Welding at the site NOT shown (prospect_test unknown); hull material not stated. Same plant as R2-D's 'Diversified Marine Services': count once.

The Riviera (Oct 2026) vessel Capt Joey Anderson is a refurbished towboat: WWJ (May 15, 2026, waterwaysjournal.net/?p=46422) says 'The mv. Capt. Joey Anderson was originally built in 2011 by Sneed Shipbuilding' and credits Southwest Shipyard with the refurbishment. Shipbuilding History: company failed 2017, Channelview yard sold to San Jac Marine (p-san-jac-marine-channelview-tx), 'The Orange shipyard continues' (EPA FRS: 2011 Dupont Dr, Orange). sneedshipbuilding.com unreachable earlier; no dated new hull after 2015 found. Not a miss under the five-year rule unless a newer build is found.

In definition on the evidence (WWJ Mar 23, 2020: 'Spartan is able to build and assemble steel components for us' - towboat cabins for Verret at a Fort Smith build site; WWJ Mar 13, 2026: 160-ft drydock being completed in Fort Smith for Verret), but no street address found: EPA FRS and ECHO name searches (AR) empty, no OSHA 2025 record, no company site found. IN DEFINITION, ADDRESS MISSING: count under either reading as the coordinator decides. Lead: needs an address source; also a Spartan -> Verret link.

Inferred: Thoma-Sea Marine Constructors is run by the Thomassie family (Marine News, Jun 2025: 'Walter Thomassie, Managing Director, Thoma-Sea Marine Constructors, LLC'; three yards, 2 new construction and 1 repair). No company named 'Thomassie Marine Constructors' was found in any registry or search; the TPEDA list carries both 'Thomassie Marine Constructors' (520) and 'Thoma-Sea Constructors' (400), probably the same group listed twice. Ledger: p-thoma-sea-houma-la and p-thoma-sea-lockport-la (both base).

Idle yard: WWJ (May 15, 2026) on the sale of Arcosa Marine to Wynnchurch/NABRICO lists 'Barge Construction: Ashland City, Tenn., and Caruthersville, Mo., as well as the currently idle Madisonville, La.' No current production; no street address on that page; no OSHA 2025 record. (Already cited in the ledger on p-arcosa-marine-caruthersville-mo:triggers.)

ECHO lists GULF COUNTY SHIPBUILDING INC, 1550 Old Dynamite Dock Rd, Port St Joe (NAICS 336611, 336612, 488390, 811490), but no source of any vessel built was found: two web searches returned only Eastern Shipbuilding's Port St. Joe yard (ledger p-eastern-port-st-joe-fl, excluded repair-only); no company site; no OSHA 2025 record.
